title: Chapter 166 Wana Village Was Attacked
content:
Chapter 166 Wana Village Was Attacked

Not long after, Wang Shuo arrived with his cavalry, and the fleeing bandits were blocked on the trail.

There was a cliff on the left, a steep cliff on the right, and spears were shooting from the other side. There was really no way up to the sky and no way down to the earth!

"We surrender!" A fearful bandit was the first to shout loudly.

Wang Shuo was immediately happy when he heard it!

It would be best if there was no bloodshed!

"Put down your weapons, and you will not die if you surrender!" Wang Shuo pointed his spear and shouted at the bandits.

All the bandits put down their weapons one after another.

After confiscating all the weapons and backpacks, Wang Shuo tied them all up again.

Then, he picked out three lucky ones.

"Do you want to go back to the village?" Wang Shuo looked at the three bandits squatting on the ground with a smile.

The three bandits were so scared that they didn't know how to answer.

If his answer did not satisfy the evil man in front of him, he might be thrown off the cliff.

They were all silent, with their heads buried between their knees.

"Now there is such an opportunity in front of you. If you don't want to go back, I will find someone else." Wang Shuo deliberately stretched out his tone and joked.

The three bandits heard it, are they really willing to let us go?

"I want to go back." They immediately raised their heads, with wonderful looks in their eyes.

"Then why don't you get out of here quickly." Wang Shuo asked the soldiers who were left behind to make way.

The three bandits tentatively stood up and found that Wang Shuo and others did not move.

They walked forward a few more steps, taking every step carefully, until they passed the obstacles set up, and then they accelerated and ran.

After reaching a safe distance, he did not forget to say a harsh word: "Just wait for me, just wait for the revenge of the boss!"

Wang Shuo sneered without comment: "Then I will wait for your boss here. Whoever doesn't come is a grandson."

After the three bandits who went back to inform the news left, Wang Shuo drove the captives back a distance and sent twenty soldiers to guard them.

The best attack position of the bronze crossbow cart was left.

Just then, Wang Shuo received a message from Duan Wenxi that someone had actually started to attack his base camp at this time.

"Can you hold it now?" Wang Shuo asked with some concern. He had withdrawn most of the troops from Wana Village at this time, but he was still a little worried.

"Lord, although the other side has hundreds of people, our city walls are not vegetarian. The other side did not carry siege equipment, and we can still hold on."

"That's good. I will return immediately after I solve the bandit problem." Wang Shuo was a little worried, but there was no way to change the plan.

If they give up on wiping out the bandits on the mountain now, they will be prepared later, and I am afraid that Qingmu Village will become a long-term threat to Wana Village.

"Boss, it's bad!" The three bandits who escaped did not disappoint Wang Shuo's expectations.

"What's going on?" Zhang Wenlong looked at the bandits in front of him, covered in blood, and had a bad premonition!

"Boss, the second in command was captured by a team of cavalry, and the brothers were all captured!"

A bandit panted and cried.

"What? How many people are there on the other side?" Zhang Wenlong asked in surprise.

"There are probably hundreds of people on the other side, and the second in command is still in their hands, and the other side is arrogant, and they don't take the boss seriously at all."

Zhang Wenlong's brows twisted into a "chuan" character.

But he did not act impulsively, but turned to look at the military advisor Zou Yuanjie.

"Yuanjie, what do you think should be done about this matter?"
